title: ST-GNN
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Multichannel context
description: Rearrange to batch x features x electrodes x time.

nodes.title: Electrode graph
description: Montage-derived adjacency and scaled graph Laplacian.

nodes.title: Two spatiotemporal blocks
description: Temporal tanh/sigmoid gate -> Chebyshev convolution -> temporal gate.
Residual projection and GroupNorm complete each block.

nodes.title: Output head
description: 1x1 convolution predicts the artifact for every electrode.

nodes.title: Centre-epoch artifact
description: Slice the centre epoch; output batch x electrodes x samples.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Multichannel context
Multichannel context to Two spatiotemporal blocks
Two spatiotemporal blocks to Output head
Centre-epoch artifact to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
